parameters.text:
=The BCBA term to explain is: {{$json.termTopic}}

You are a BCBA expert creating SHORT-FORM BCBA TERMS content for slide-based videos.

You MUST output content in **strict Markdown format** following the exact structure below.
Formatting errors are NOT allowed.

================ FORMAT RULES (MANDATORY) ================

1. Output must be written in English only.
2. Use Markdown formatting exactly as shown.
3. Title must be MAX 15 characters.
4. Each page must contain 3–4 bullet points.
5. Each bullet point must be MAX 12 words.
6. Use **bold** for key concepts only.

---------------- CRITICAL STRUCTURE RULE ----------------

• The separator line `---` MUST appear **ONLY ONCE**.
• It MUST appear **immediately before [Page 1]**.
• The [Cover] section MUST NOT have `---` above or below it.
• NO other pages may have `---` before them.

================ REQUIRED OUTPUT TEMPLATE ================

[Cover]
Title: {{$json.termTopic}}
Subtitle:Subtitle: BCBA Exam Essential

---
[Page 1]
Page Title: <Title>
Content:
- Bullet 1
- Bullet 2
- Bullet 3

[Page 2]
Page Title: <Title>
Content:
- Bullet 1
- Bullet 2
- Bullet 3

[Page 3]
Page Title: <Title>
Content:
- Bullet 1
- Bullet 2
- Bullet 3

================ END OF RULES ============================

Follow this structure EXACTLY.
Do not add extra sections.
Do not move the separator.
Do not explain your output.
Only return the formatted content.

options.systemMessage:
You are a BCBA expert and instructional designer.

You write clear, visually scannable educational content optimized for slide-based short videos.

Your writing must be accurate, concise, and suitable for automated visual rendering.

parameters.command:
=sh -lc '
set -e

IMGDIR="{{$json.imageDir}}"
RUNDIR="{{$json.runDir}}"

mkdir -p "$RUNDIR"

echo "== copy images =="
cp "$IMGDIR"/*.png "$RUNDIR"/

echo "== 1. cover.mp4 (2s silent) =="
ffmpeg -y \
  -loop 1 -i "$RUNDIR/cover.png" \
  -f lavfi -i anullsrc=channel_layout=mono:sample_rate=22050 \
  -t 2 \
  -vf "scale=ceil(iw/2)*2:ceil(ih/2)*2" \
  -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 30 \
  -c:a aac \
  "$RUNDIR/cover.mp4"

echo "== 2. page videos =="
for img in "$RUNDIR"/page-*.png; do
  name=$(basename "$img" .png)
  audio="/data/${name}.mp3"
  out="$RUNDIR/${name}.mp4"

  echo "Rendering $out"
  ffmpeg -y \
    -loop 1 -i "$img" \
    -i "$audio" \
    -vf "scale=ceil(iw/2)*2:ceil(ih/2)*2" \
    -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 30 \
    -c:a aac -b:a 128k \
    -shortest \
    "$out"
done

echo "== 3. write concat list =="
printf "file '\''%s/cover.mp4'\''\n" "$RUNDIR" > "$RUNDIR/list.txt"

for f in "$RUNDIR"/page-*.mp4; do
  printf "file '\''%s'\''\n" "$f" >> "$RUNDIR/list.txt"
done

cat "$RUNDIR/list.txt"

echo "== 4. concat final.mp4 =="
ffmpeg -y \
  -f concat -safe 0 \
  -i "$RUNDIR/list.txt" \
  -c copy \
  "$RUNDIR/final.mp4"

echo "== DONE =="
ls -lh "$RUNDIR"
'
